One file that carries the whole brand.

This is the Bitcoin Computer design system. It holds the logo, the color palette, the Formular typeface, the type scale, spacing, the interface components used by the explorer, and the rules for using them. Everything is embedded in this one HTML file, so it works offline and can be handed to a designer, a developer or an AI agent as a single object.

It covers two surfaces with one set of values. The product interface, which is the explorer and any other application, and the website. Each has its own components, and both read from the same colors, type and spacing.

Version1.0.0
Date2026-09-22
TypefaceFormular, 4 faces
Primary color#0046FF
Embedded files22
SurfacesProduct and website

How to use this file

Read it, copy from it, or parse it. The same values appear in the visible sections, in the CSS at the top of the file, and in a JSON block that a machine can read directly.

If you are designing

Use the colors in the Color section by their role: heading, body text, link, border, surface, status. Set type in Formular using the scale in Typography. Build screens from the components shown here rather than inventing new ones. Download the logo and font files from the Assets section.

If you are building

Copy the CSS variables from the Code section into your global stylesheet, or use the Tailwind config there. Load the fonts with the font-face block, either with the embedded base64 data or with the woff2 files from Assets. Match the reference markup under each component. The classes are prefixed bc- so they will not collide with anything existing.

If you are an AI agent

The HTML comment at the very top of this file and the JSON block with the id bc-design-system are written for you. The JSON is the authoritative specification: colors, roles, type, components, rules, and every asset as base64. When the prose and the JSON disagree, follow the JSON. The Machine-readable section at the end summarizes the structure.

Logo

The mark is a circle holding a square with clipped corners. The full logo places the mark beside the name set on two lines in Formular Bold. There is one mark, and it does not change shape between uses.

Blue on white. The default.
White on blue-900. Dark surfaces and dark mode.
White on blue-500. Marketing bands, social images.
Black. One-color print only.

The mark alone

Use the mark by itself wherever the name is already present or space is tight: the navigation bar, app icons, favicons and avatars. On screen it is never smaller than 24px. The full logo is never narrower than 120px.

Mark, blue
Mark, white
24, 32, 48 and 64px

Clear space and placement

Blue on white or on neutral-50 is the default and should be used whenever possible. White is for blue-500 and blue-900 surfaces. Black exists only for single-color print jobs, for example a stamp or an engraving.

In product interfaces the mark sits at 24px in the navigation bar next to the product name, as in the explorer. The full logo belongs on the website, in documents, presentations and social images.

What not to do

Do not recolor the mark
Do not rotate it
Do not stretch it
Do not add a shadow or outline
Do not place it on busy imagery
Do not enclose it in another shape

Neutral

Headings use blue-900 rather than a gray, which is what gives the interface its brand color even when no blue-500 is on screen. Body text is neutral-900. Neutral-600 is for large text only; it fails contrast below 18px, which is why neutral-700 exists for secondary text.

Typography

Formular by Brownfox is the only typeface. Regular carries text, Bold carries headings and labels, Italic is for emphasis inside sentences, and Formular Mono carries anything a person might copy: hashes, revisions, addresses, keys, amounts and code. Using one family everywhere is what makes the explorer, the website and documents read as one product.

Formular · weight 400 · normalBody, interface text, display headlines
Turing complete smart contracts on Bitcoin
ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789 &@#%$€£()[]{}.,;:!?

Sizes are fixed, not fluid. Interface text defaults to 14px. Paragraph text in documents and marketing is 16px. The display size exists for the website only.

Rules

Headings are Bold with slightly tightened tracking at 24px and above. Uppercase appears only in the label style, which is limited to table headers, card field labels and badges. Mono text is never letter-spaced. Line length in documents stays under 72 characters.

License

Formular is a commercial typeface by Brownfox (Gayane Bagdasaryan and Vyacheslav Kirilenko). The files embedded here are Brownfox webfont kits in Regular, Italic, Bold and Mono. Using them on a public website requires a web license from brownfox.org.

Spacing and layout

A 4px base, one border weight, two corner radii and no shadows. Hierarchy comes from spacing, borders and type, not from elevation.

Spacing

space-14px
space-28px
space-312px
space-416px
space-520px
space-624px
space-832px
space-1040px
space-1248px
space-1664px

Radius

4px on small things such as badges, skeleton blocks and inline code. 8px on cards, inputs, buttons, banners and menus. Full radius on pills and dots.

radius-sm 4px
radius-md 8px
radius-full 999px

Borders and shadows

Borders are always 1px. Default borders use border.default (neutral-200), interactive controls use border.strong (neutral-300), and focus is a 2px outline in border.focus with 2px offset. Surfaces are flat. The single exception is the overlay shadow, 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 15, 56, 0.12), which is allowed on dropdown menus and dialogs because they float over content.

Layout

Content sits in a container of at most 1200px with 24px gutters, on a 12-column grid with 24px gaps. The navigation bar is 56px tall. Controls are 36px tall, or 32px in the small size. Cards use 16px padding. Breakpoints are 640, 960 and 1200px.

The pieces the explorer is made of, rendered live with the tokens in this file. Each one has its reference markup underneath. Toggle dark mode at the top of the page to see the same components on the dark surfaces.

A filter, a text input and one primary button. The hints underneath use type badges to show the accepted formats.

Buttons

Primary for the one main action on a view. Outline for secondary actions. Ghost for reset and cancel. Disabled controls keep their size and lose their color.

Reference markup
<div class="demo-row">
  <button class="bc-btn bc-btn-primary" type="button">Create object</button>
  <button class="bc-btn bc-btn-outline" type="button">Preview effect</button>
  <button class="bc-btn bc-btn-ghost" type="button">Reset</button>
  <button class="bc-btn bc-btn-primary" type="button" disabled>Create object</button>
  <button class="bc-btn bc-btn-primary bc-btn-sm" type="button">Search</button>
  <button class="bc-btn bc-btn-outline bc-btn-sm" type="button">Load Counter example</button>
</div>

Inputs

Inputs sit on surface.alt with a strong border. Hash and identifier inputs use Formular Mono. Errors change the border to danger-500 and add a help line.

Amount in BTC
Public keys are 66 hex characters starting with 02 or 03.

Code

Code sits on surface.inset in Formular Mono. No syntax coloring beyond the text color; the block is for reading and copying.

import { Contract } from '@bitcoin-computer/lib'

export class Counter extends Contract {
  constructor() { super({ n: 0 }) }
  inc() { this.n += 1 }
}

Inline references use effect.res in the same face.

Reference markup
<pre class="bc-code">import { Contract } from '@bitcoin-computer/lib'

export class Counter extends Contract {
  constructor() { super({ n: 0 }) }
  inc() { this.n += 1 }
}</pre>
<p class="small" style="margin-top:12px">Inline references use <code class="bc-inline">effect.res</code> in the same face.</p>

Website

The website uses the same tokens as the product with larger type and more room. It has four backgrounds: white, neutral-50, blue-500 and blue-900. Nothing sits behind text. Each piece below is a section of a page; a page is the navigation, a hero, a run of sections, at most one blue band and one navy band, a closing call to action and the footer.

Navigation

The full logo at 32px tall, a few text links, one primary button. On phones the links collapse and the button stays.

Hero

The headline is the display style in Formular Regular: 48px, 64px on wide screens. One primary action and one outline action.

JavaScript smart contracts on Bitcoin

A Turing complete metaprotocol for UTXO-based blockchains. Write a class, deploy it as a smart contract, and read its state from any node.

Read the quickstartOpen the explorer
Reference markup
<section class="bc-hero"><div class="bc-wrap">
  <h1 class="bc-display">JavaScript smart contracts on Bitcoin</h1>
  <p class="bc-lead">A Turing complete metaprotocol for UTXO-based blockchains. Write a class, deploy it as a smart contract, and read its state from any node.</p>
  <div class="bc-hero-actions"><a class="bc-btn bc-btn-primary bc-btn-lg" href="#">Read the quickstart</a><a class="bc-btn bc-btn-outline bc-btn-lg" href="#">Open the explorer</a></div>
</div></section>

Features

Sections alternate white and neutral-50. A feature is a blue dot, a Bold title and one short paragraph. No icons.

Built for the way Bitcoin works

Smart contracts live in transaction outputs. The owner of the output owns the object, and every update is a signed transaction.

Easy to use

Smart contracts are written in JavaScript. If you know JavaScript, you can write smart contracts.

Free computation

Execution cost does not grow with the number of steps. Every transaction costs the same as a payment.

Pure Bitcoin

No side chain and no separate token. Contracts work as long as Bitcoin is available.

Off-chain storage

Choose what is stored on chain and what is hashed and kept on a node.

Encryption

Contract data can be encrypted end to end while flows of money stay visible.

Every state, forever

All historical states of an object are recorded in spent outputs and can be read back.

  <div class="bc-section-head"><h2>Built for the way Bitcoin works</h2><p>Smart contracts live in transaction outputs. The owner of the output owns the object, and every update is a signed transaction.</p></div>
  <div class="bc-features">
    <div class="bc-feature"><h3>Easy to use</h3><p>Smart contracts are written in JavaScript. If you know JavaScript, you can write smart contracts.</p></div>
    <div class="bc-feature"><h3>Free computation</h3><p>Execution cost does not grow with the number of steps. Every transaction costs the same as a payment.</p></div>
    <div class="bc-feature"><h3>Pure Bitcoin</h3><p>No side chain and no separate token. Contracts work as long as Bitcoin is available.</p></div>
    <div class="bc-feature"><h3>Off-chain storage</h3><p>Choose what is stored on chain and what is hashed and kept on a node.</p></div>
    <div class="bc-feature"><h3>Encryption</h3><p>Contract data can be encrypted end to end while flows of money stay visible.</p></div>
    <div class="bc-feature"><h3>Every state, forever</h3><p>All historical states of an object are recorded in spent outputs and can be read back.</p></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

Code example

Code beside its result, using the product code block. The result panel is a raised card.

A token in six lines

Deploy the class, create an object from it, send it to another owner.

import { Contract } from '@bitcoin-computer/lib'

export class Token extends Contract {
  constructor(state) { super({ state }) }
  setState(state) { this.state = state }
  send(to) { this._owners = [to] }
}

const token = await computer.new(Token, ['myState'])
Result
A token has been created.
Token {
  state: 'myState',
  _id:  '656f…a024:0',
  _rev: '90f2…c73f:0'
}

Dark mode

Dark mode swaps roles, not components. The page surface becomes blue-900, raised surfaces a slightly lighter navy, headings turn white, body text neutral-100, and links use blue-300 so they stay readable. The primary button keeps blue-500 with white text in both modes.

The CSS in this file supports both an explicit data-theme="dark" attribute on the root element and the operating system preference through prefers-color-scheme. Set the attribute when a person chooses a theme; leave it off to follow the system. Status badges invert on dark: the 900 step becomes the background and the 100 tint becomes the text, which keeps every pair above a 5:1 ratio.

Use the switch in the top bar to view this entire document in dark mode.

  --bc-shadow-overlay: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 15, 56, 0.12);
  /* Semantic roles, light */
  --bc-surface-page: var(--bc-neutral-0);

  --bc-text-on-action: var(--bc-neutral-0);
  --bc-action-primary: var(--bc-blue-500);
  --bc-action-primary-hover: var(--bc-blue-700);
  --bc-action-outline: var(--bc-blue-500);
  --bc-status-success-bg: var(--bc-success-100);
  --bc-status-success-text: var(--bc-success-900);
  --bc-status-warning-bg: var(--bc-warning-100);
  --bc-status-warning-text: var(--bc-warning-900);

  --bc-brand-logo: var(--bc-blue-500);
  color-scheme: light;
}
[data-theme="dark"] {

Tailwind and Flowbite

This config is the whole palette twice. The brand names (blue, neutral, success, warning, danger) are what new code should use. The primary, blue, gray, green, yellow and red scales repeat the same values under the names Flowbite's components reference, so a Flowbite button, badge, alert or table lands on brand values without editing each one. The steps are intentionally uneven; the table after the config shows what each Flowbite class becomes.

// tailwind.config.js
// Brand names (blue, neutral, success, warning, danger) are the system. The primary, blue, gray, green,
// yellow and red scales repeat the same values under the names Flowbite's components use, so every
// Flowbite class lands on a brand value. Duplicated steps are deliberate.
// Semantic roles live in CSS variables; use them as arbitrary values, e.g. bg-[var(--bc-surface-raised)].
module.exports = {
  "content": [
    "./index.html",
    "./src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}",
    "./node_modules/flowbite/**/*.js",
    "./node_modules/flowbite-react/**/*.js"
  ],
  "darkMode": [
    "class",
    "[data-theme='dark']"
  ],
  "plugins": [require("flowbite/plugin")],

Flowbite never sets the page background. Set it yourself with surface.page so dark mode is navy rather than gray-900. Flowbite's dark borders use gray-700, which here is the navy border tone, so in light mode text-gray-700 reads as a dark navy rather than a gray; that is the one visible compromise of the remap.

flowbite-react theme

For projects on flowbite-react, this theme object restyles the components the explorer uses with the classes from the config above. Key names follow flowbite-react 0.10; check them against the installed version before use.

// flowbiteTheme.js
// Pass to flowbite-react. Key names follow flowbite-react 0.10; check them against the installed version.

//   <Flowbite theme={{ theme: bcTheme }}> ... </Flowbite>

Component CSS

The reference implementation used to render this document.

/* ==========================================================================
   Bitcoin Computer design system: reference component styles.
   Every value is a token. Copy this block, or rebuild it in Tailwind with
   the config in the Code section. Class prefix: bc-
   ========================================================================== */
.bc-reset, .bc-reset * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.bc-sans { font-family: var(--bc-font-sans); }
.bc-mono { font-family: var(--bc-font-mono); }

/* Navigation bar */
.bc-nav { display:flex; overflow-x:auto; align-items:center; gap: var(--bc-space-6); height: var(--bc-nav-height); padding: 0 var(--bc-space-6); background: var(--bc-surface-raised); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bc-border-default); font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); }
.bc-nav-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--bc-space-2); color: var(--bc-text-heading); font-weight:700; font-size:16px; text-decoration:none; }
.bc-nav-brand svg { width:24px; height:24px; color: var(--bc-brand-logo); }
.bc-nav-links { display:flex; gap: var(--bc-space-5); margin-left:auto; }
.bc-nav-links a { color: var(--bc-text-primary); text-decoration:none; }
.bc-nav-links a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--bc-text-link); }
.bc-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--bc-text-link); }

/* Buttons */
.bc-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap: var(--bc-space-2); height: var(--bc-control-height); padding: 0 var(--bc-space-4); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); border:1px solid transparent; font: 700 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; transition: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms, color 120ms; }
.bc-btn-primary { background: var(--bc-action-primary); color: var(--bc-text-on-action); }
.bc-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--bc-action-primary-hover); }
.bc-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--bc-action-outline); border-color: var(--bc-action-outline); }
.bc-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--bc-action-primary); border-color: var(--bc-action-primary); color: var(--bc-text-on-action); }
.bc-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--bc-text-primary); border-color: var(--bc-border-strong); }
.bc-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--bc-text-primary); }
.bc-btn[disabled], .bc-btn.is-disabled { background: var(--bc-surface-inset); color: var(--bc-text-disabled); border-color: var(--bc-border-default); cursor:not-allowed; }
.bc-btn-sm { height: var(--bc-control-height-sm); padding: 0 var(--bc-space-3); font-size:13px; }
.bc-btn-lg { height: var(--bc-control-height-lg); padding: 0 var(--bc-space-5); font-size:16px; }
.bc-btn:focus-visible, .bc-input:focus-visible, .bc-select:focus-visible, .bc-tab:focus-visible, .bc-page-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--bc-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* Inputs */
.bc-field-label { display:block; font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); margin-bottom: var(--bc-space-1); }
.bc-input, .bc-select { width:100%; height: var(--bc-control-height); padding: 0 var(--bc-space-3); background: var(--bc-surface-alt); border:1px solid var(--bc-border-strong); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); }
.bc-input::placeholder { color: var(--bc-text-disabled); }
.bc-input:focus, .bc-select:focus { outline:none; border-color: var(--bc-border-focus); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--bc-border-focus); }
.bc-input.is-error { border-color: var(--bc-danger-500); }
.bc-input[disabled] { color: var(--bc-text-disabled); background: var(--bc-surface-inset); }
.bc-help { font: 400 12px/16px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); margin-top: var(--bc-space-1); }
.bc-help.is-error { color: var(--bc-status-danger-text); }
.bc-input.bc-mono { font-family: var(--bc-font-mono); font-size:13px; }

/* Search bar */
.bc-search { display:flex; gap: var(--bc-space-2); align-items:stretch; }
.bc-search .bc-select { width:150px; flex:none; }
.bc-search .bc-input { flex:1; min-width:0; }
@media (max-width: 639px) { .bc-search { flex-wrap:wrap; } .bc-search .bc-select { width:100%; } }
.bc-search-hints { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap: var(--bc-space-2); align-items:center; margin-top: var(--bc-space-3); font: 400 12px/16px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); }

/* Badges */
.bc-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:20px; padding:0 6px; border-radius: var(--bc-radius-sm); font: 700 11px/16px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; }
.bc-badge-type { background: var(--bc-surface-inset); color: var(--bc-text-primary); }
.bc-badge-ref { background: var(--bc-status-info-bg); color: var(--bc-status-info-text); font: 400 12px/16px var(--bc-font-mono); letter-spacing:0; text-transform:none; }
.bc-badge-success { background: var(--bc-status-success-bg); color: var(--bc-status-success-text); }
.bc-badge-warning { background: var(--bc-status-warning-bg); color: var(--bc-status-warning-text); }
.bc-badge-danger  { background: var(--bc-status-danger-bg);  color: var(--bc-status-danger-text); }
.bc-badge-info    { background: var(--bc-status-info-bg);    color: var(--bc-status-info-text); }
.bc-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius: var(--bc-radius-full); display:inline-block; }
.bc-dot-success { background: var(--bc-success-500); } .bc-dot-warning { background: var(--bc-warning-500); } .bc-dot-danger { background: var(--bc-danger-500); } .bc-dot-info { background: var(--bc-blue-500); }

/* Card */
.bc-card { background: var(--bc-surface-raised); border:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); padding: var(--bc-space-4); font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); }
.bc-card-head { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap: var(--bc-space-3); padding-bottom: var(--bc-space-3); border-bottom:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); margin-bottom: var(--bc-space-2); }
.bc-card-title { font: 700 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-heading); display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--bc-space-2); flex-wrap:wrap; }
.bc-card-sub { font: 400 12px/16px var(--bc-font-mono); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); margin-top:2px; }
.bc-card-meta { font: 400 12px/16px var(--bc-font-mono); color: var(--bc-text-link); white-space:nowrap; }
.bc-card-meta.is-mempool { color: var(--bc-status-warning-text); }
.bc-field-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 96px auto 1fr; gap: var(--bc-space-3); align-items:center; padding: var(--bc-space-2) 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); }
.bc-field-row:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
.bc-field-row .k { color: var(--bc-text-secondary); }
.bc-field-row .v { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
.bc-card-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: var(--bc-space-4); }

/* Table */
.bc-table-wrap { border:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); overflow:auto; background: var(--bc-surface-raised); }
.bc-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); }
.bc-table th { text-align:left; background: var(--bc-surface-alt); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); font: 700 11px/16px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; padding: var(--bc-space-3) var(--bc-space-4); border-bottom:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); white-space:nowrap; }
.bc-table td { padding: 10px var(--bc-space-4); border-bottom:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); vertical-align:middle; }
.bc-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom:0; }
.bc-table a { color: var(--bc-text-link); text-decoration:none; }
.bc-table a:hover { text-decoration:underline; }
.bc-table .mono { font: 400 13px/20px var(--bc-font-mono); white-space:nowrap; }
.bc-table .clip { max-width:280px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.bc-table .num { text-align:right; font-family: var(--bc-font-mono); font-size:13px; }

/* Banner */
.bc-banner { display:flex; gap: var(--bc-space-3); align-items:flex-start; padding: var(--bc-space-3) var(--bc-space-4); border:1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); }
.bc-banner strong { font-weight:700; }
.bc-banner-info    { background: var(--bc-status-info-surface);    color: var(--bc-status-info-text);    border-color: var(--bc-status-info-bg); }
.bc-banner-warning { background: var(--bc-status-warning-surface); color: var(--bc-status-warning-text); border-color: var(--bc-status-warning-bg); }
.bc-banner-danger  { background: var(--bc-status-danger-surface);  color: var(--bc-status-danger-text);  border-color: var(--bc-status-danger-bg); }
.bc-banner-success { background: var(--bc-status-success-surface); color: var(--bc-status-success-text); border-color: var(--bc-status-success-bg); }

/* Tabs */
.bc-tabs { display:inline-flex; border:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); overflow:hidden; background: var(--bc-surface-raised); }
.bc-tab { height: var(--bc-control-height-sm); padding:0 var(--bc-space-4); background:transparent; border:0; border-right:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); cursor:pointer; }
.bc-tab:last-child { border-right:0; }
.bc-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--bc-status-info-bg); color: var(--bc-status-info-text); font-weight:700; }
.bc-tabs-underline { display:flex; gap: var(--bc-space-6); border-bottom:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); }
.bc-tabs-underline .bc-tab { border:0; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; margin-bottom:-1px; padding:0 0 var(--bc-space-2) 0; height:auto; }
.bc-tabs-underline .bc-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background:transparent; color: var(--bc-text-heading); border-bottom-color: var(--bc-action-primary); }

/* Pagination */
.bc-pagination { display:inline-flex; gap: var(--bc-space-2); }
.bc-page-btn { height: var(--bc-control-height-sm); min-width: var(--bc-control-height-sm); padding:0 var(--bc-space-3); background: var(--bc-surface-raised); border:1px solid var(--bc-border-strong); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); cursor:pointer; }
.bc-page-btn:hover { border-color: var(--bc-text-primary); }
.bc-page-btn[disabled] { color: var(--bc-text-disabled); border-color: var(--bc-border-default); cursor:not-allowed; }

/* Skeleton */
.bc-skeleton { background: var(--bc-surface-inset); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-sm); height:12px; animation: bc-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes bc-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity:1 } 50% { opacity:.55 } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .bc-skeleton { animation:none; } .bc-btn { transition:none; } }

/* Code */
.bc-code { display:block; background: var(--bc-surface-inset); color: var(--bc-text-primary); border:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); padding: var(--bc-space-3) var(--bc-space-4); font: 400 13px/20px var(--bc-font-mono); overflow:auto; white-space:pre; margin:0; }
code.bc-inline { font: 400 0.9em/1 var(--bc-font-mono); background: var(--bc-surface-inset); padding:1px 5px; border-radius: var(--bc-radius-sm); }

/* Key-value detail list (block detail page) */
.bc-detail { background: var(--bc-surface-raised); border:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); }
.bc-detail-row { padding: var(--bc-space-3) var(--bc-space-4); border-bottom:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); }
.bc-detail-row:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
.bc-detail-row .k { display:block; font: 700 11px/16px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:0.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color: var(--bc-text-secondary); margin-bottom:2px; }
.bc-detail-row .v { font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); word-break: break-all; }
.bc-detail-row .v.mono { font-family: var(--bc-font-mono); font-size:13px; }

/* ==========================================================================
   Website components. Same tokens, larger type, four flat backgrounds.
   ========================================================================== */
.bc-site { font: 400 16px/24px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-primary); background: var(--bc-surface-page); }
.bc-wrap { max-width: var(--bc-container-max); margin:0 auto; padding: 0 var(--bc-space-6); }

/* Marketing navigation */
.bc-mnav { height:64px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); background: var(--bc-surface-page); }
.bc-mnav .bc-wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--bc-space-8); height:100%; }
.bc-mnav-logo { display:block; color: var(--bc-brand-logo); }
.bc-mnav-logo svg { height:32px; width:auto; display:block; }
.bc-mnav-links { display:flex; gap: var(--bc-space-6); margin-left:auto; }
.bc-mnav-links a { color: var(--bc-text-primary); text-decoration:none; }
.bc-mnav-links a:hover { color: var(--bc-text-link); }
@media (max-width: 639px) { .bc-mnav-links { display:none; } .bc-mnav .bc-btn { margin-left:auto; } }

/* Hero */
.bc-hero { padding: var(--bc-space-16) 0; }
.bc-display { font: 400 48px/52px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:-0.02em; color: var(--bc-text-heading); margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-6); max-width: 18ch; }
@media (min-width: 960px) { .bc-hero { padding: 96px 0; } .bc-hero .bc-display { font-size:64px; line-height:68px; } }
.bc-lead { font: 400 20px/28px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); max-width: 56ch; margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-8); }
.bc-hero-actions { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap: var(--bc-space-3); }

/* Sections */
.bc-section { padding: var(--bc-space-16) 0; }
.bc-section.alt { background: var(--bc-surface-alt); }
@media (min-width: 960px) { .bc-section { padding: 96px 0; } }
.bc-section-head { max-width: 64ch; margin-bottom: var(--bc-space-10); }
.bc-section-head h2 { font: 700 32px/40px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:-0.01em; color: var(--bc-text-heading); margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-3); }
.bc-section-head p { font: 400 20px/28px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); margin:0; }

/* Features */
.bc-features { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: var(--bc-space-10) var(--bc-space-8); }
.bc-feature h3 { font: 700 16px/24px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-heading); margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-2); display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--bc-space-2); }
.bc-feature h3::before { content:""; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius: var(--bc-radius-full); background: var(--bc-action-primary); flex:none; }
.bc-feature p { font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); margin:0; max-width: 40ch; }

/* Code example: code beside its result */
.bc-example { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--bc-space-4); }
@media (min-width: 960px) { .bc-example { grid-template-columns: 3fr 2fr; } }
.bc-example > .bc-code { min-height:100%; }
.bc-result { border:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); padding: var(--bc-space-4); background: var(--bc-surface-raised); font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); }
.bc-result .bc-code { margin-top: var(--bc-space-3); min-height:0; }

/* Bands */
.bc-band { padding: var(--bc-space-12) 0; color: #FFFFFF; }
.bc-band-blue { background: var(--bc-blue-500); }
.bc-band-navy { background: var(--bc-blue-900); }
.bc-band h2 { font: 400 32px/40px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:#FFFFFF; margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-4); max-width: 24ch; }
.bc-band p { max-width: 56ch; margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-6); }
.bc-band-blue p { color:#FFFFFF; }
.bc-band-navy p { color: var(--bc-blue-100); }
.bc-band .bc-btn-white { background:#FFFFFF; color: var(--bc-blue-500); border-color:#FFFFFF; }
.bc-band .bc-btn-white:hover { background: var(--bc-blue-100); border-color: var(--bc-blue-100); }
.bc-band-navy .bc-btn-outline { color:#FFFFFF; border-color:#FFFFFF; }
.bc-band-navy .bc-btn-outline:hover { background:#FFFFFF; color: var(--bc-blue-900); }

/* Pricing */
.bc-pricing { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: var(--bc-space-4); }
.bc-price { border:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); border-radius: var(--bc-radius-md); background: var(--bc-surface-raised); padding: var(--bc-space-6); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap: var(--bc-space-2); }
.bc-price .name { font: 700 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); }
.bc-price .amount { font: 400 32px/40px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:-0.01em; color: var(--bc-text-heading); }
.bc-price p { font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-text-secondary); margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-4); flex:1; }
.bc-price.is-highlight { border-color: var(--bc-action-primary); }

/* Closing call to action */
.bc-cta { padding: var(--bc-space-16) 0; border-top:1px solid var(--bc-border-default); }
.bc-cta h2 { font: 400 32px/40px var(--bc-font-sans); letter-spacing:-0.01em; color: var(--bc-text-heading); margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-6); max-width: 24ch; }

/* Footer */
.bc-footer { background: var(--bc-blue-900); color:#FFFFFF; padding: var(--bc-space-12) 0 var(--bc-space-8); }
.bc-footer .bc-wrap { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--bc-space-8); }
@media (min-width: 640px) { .bc-footer .bc-wrap { grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; } }
.bc-footer-logo { color:#FFFFFF; display:block; }
.bc-footer-logo svg { height:36px; width:auto; display:block; margin-bottom: var(--bc-space-3); }
.bc-footer p { font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-blue-100); margin:0; max-width: 36ch; }
.bc-footer h4 { font: 700 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); color:#FFFFFF; margin:0 0 var(--bc-space-3); }
.bc-footer ul { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font: 400 14px/20px var(--bc-font-sans); }
.bc-footer li { margin-bottom: var(--bc-space-2); }
.bc-footer a { color: var(--bc-blue-100); text-decoration:none; }
.bc-footer a:hover { color:#FFFFFF; text-decoration:underline; }
.bc-footer-bottom { max-width: var(--bc-container-max); margin: var(--bc-space-10) auto 0; padding: var(--bc-space-6) var(--bc-space-6) 0; border-top:1px solid var(--bc-blue-700); font: 400 12px/16px var(--bc-font-sans); color: var(--bc-blue-300); }

Rules

The short list that keeps the system a system.

Do

  • Use blue-500 for exactly one thing per view: the primary action or the link. Everything else stays neutral.
  • Set all text in Formular. Regular for text, Bold for headings and labels, Mono for anything a user might copy: hashes, revisions, addresses, keys, code.
  • Build hierarchy with spacing, borders and the type scale. Surfaces are flat. No shadows except the overlay shadow on menus and dialogs.
  • Keep one border weight (1px) and two radii (4px small, 8px everything else). Pills use the full radius.
  • Show status with a tinted background and the matching 900 text color. Confirmed is success, mempool and pending are warning, failed is danger, references are info.
  • Use the mark alone in the navigation bar and as the app icon. Use the full logo on the website and in documents.
  • Read the colors, fonts and roles from the machine-readable block in this file rather than restating them.

Do not

  • Do not introduce a second blue, a second gray scale, or any tint that is not in this file.
  • Do not use a typeface other than Formular anywhere, including code samples and the website.
  • Do not use uppercase outside table headers, card field labels and badges.
  • Do not use neutral-600 (#787878) for text under 18px. It fails contrast. Use neutral-700.
  • Do not use status 500 or 700 colors as small text on white. Use the 900 step.
  • Do not recolor, rotate, outline, add effects to, or place the logo on a busy background.
  • Do not add a shadow to a card, a button or an input.
  • Do not put patterns, gradients, illustrations or photography behind text.

Website

  • Backgrounds are flat and limited to four: white, neutral-50, blue-500 and blue-900. Sections alternate between white and neutral-50; at most one blue-500 band and one blue-900 band per page, the footer counting as the blue-900 band.
  • Display sizes are set in Formular Regular, not Bold, with tightened tracking. Section titles use h1 (32px) in Bold. Intro paragraphs use lead (20px).
  • Text is left aligned and never wider than 64 characters. Headlines stay under 20 characters per line.
  • One primary button per screen. A second action is an outline button. Website buttons use the large size (44px).
  • The navigation shows the full logo at 32px tall, a few text links and one primary button. The footer sits on blue-900 with the white logo.
  • Code samples on the website use the same code block as the product, on surface.inset in Formular Mono.
  • Feature lists use a title and one short paragraph each, marked with a blue-500 dot. No icons, no illustrations.

Machine-readable

A JSON script element with the id bc-design-system at the top of this file contains the entire system as data, and an HTML comment just above it explains how to read it.

Top-level keys: instructions (how to read and comply), tokens (color, darkExtra, roles, font, typeScale, space, radius, border, shadow, layout), components, logo, rules (do, dont, website), code (cssVariables, fontFaceEmbedded, fontFaceFiles, tailwindConfig, flowbiteReactTheme, flowbiteColorMap, componentCss) and assets, where each entry carries its mime type, filename and base64 data.

An agent should read tokens.roles to pick colors, tokens.typeScale to set type, components to build product pieces, components.website for marketing pages, and rules before finishing. To extract a file, decode assets[id].data from base64 and save it under assets[id].filename.

Design system v1.0.0, 2026-09-22. This document is built from the same tokens and components it describes.

Formular is a typeface by Brownfox and requires a web license for public sites.
